description: Returns the published dyscalculia prevalence entries, one per population study or guideline: the figure or range in percent, sample size, publication year, stated age, a calc flag (true when the site calculated the figure itself) and the reference key with a short citation. Use this when you need a prevalence number and its source; use list_chart_data instead for the page's other datasets (persistence, sex ratio, comorbidity, maths anxiety, interventions, the by-country table), and get_reference or list_studies to look up sources rather than figures. Filters combine (all must match); with none, it returns all 10 entries in the page's order, not sorted by figure or year, together with count, the statistics page URL and its last-updated date. An unknown study id returns an error listing the valid ids, and min_pct above max_pct returns an error; the entry id is only a label in this dataset, so to cite a number cite its study via get_reference. These are published research estimates, not a diagnosis of any person. There is no worldwide pooled meta-analysis of dyscalculia prevalence: the 'worldwide' entry is a range across population studies. Studies use different criteria and ages, so figures are not directly comparable.

age.description: Age in whole years, 3 to 99, e.g. 11. Keeps entries whose stated age range includes it. Entries with no numeric age range are never matched; their ids are returned in notMatchedBecauseNoStatedAge.

max_pct.description: Upper bound in percent, 0 to 100. Keeps entries whose figure, or the lower end of whose range, is at most this. Combine with min_pct for an overlap window.

min_pct.description: Lower bound in percent, 0 to 100. Keeps entries whose figure, or the upper end of whose range, is at least this. Combine with max_pct for an overlap window; must not exceed max_pct.

study.description: Exact entry id (case-sensitive); returns only that entry. One of: worldwide-range, german-guideline, israel-1996, brazil-2016, uk-morsanyi-2018, england-devine-2018, england-devine-2013, uk-lewis-1994, flanders-2004, inserm-2007. Omit for all entries.

name: get_prevalence
title: Dyscalculia prevalence figures
